description: This file defines internal structures, constants, and function prototypes for the reverb effect implementation in an audio processing library. It includes class and method declarations related to reverb processing, filter configurations, and parameter management.

classes.name: LVREV_FastData_st
classes.description: Structure holding filter taps for high pass, low pass, and reverb low pass filters.

classes.name: LVREV_FastCoef_st
classes.description: Structure containing filter coefficient instances for high pass, low pass, and reverb low pass filters.

classes.name: LVREV_Instance_st
classes.description: Main data structure representing an instance of the reverb effect, including parameters, memory pointers, and filter states.

methods.name: LVREV_ApplyNewSettings
methods.description: Function to apply new reverb settings to the instance.

methods.name: ReverbBlock
methods.description: Processes a block of audio data through the reverb effect.

methods.name: BypassMixer_Callback
methods.description: Callback function for bypassing the reverb effect, typically used for dry/wet mixing.
